alerts.title: Iran’s Disappearing Oil Is Becoming Everyone’s Problem
alerts.why: Loss of Iranian oil tightens global supply, drives up replacement costs, and raises geopolitical risks in the Strait of Hormuz.

alerts.title: Iran war live: Trump hints US could strike Iran, warns time coming
alerts.why: Trump's threats of military action against Iran raise geopolitical risk premiums in the Middle East, boosting safe-haven gold and oil supply fears.
